fusions.name: Spun Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone of silk that deals 10 damage to everything caught in it and [Slows] each for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Bound Prey
fusions.desc: Casts a silk-wrapped tine that deals 36 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. It also deals 5% of a boss or elite target's maximum health.

fusions.name: Strand Line
fusions.desc: Strings a line of silk 5 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds that enemies cannot pass.

fusions.name: Anchored Threads
fusions.desc: Every hit you land binds a stack of silk on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
